claim_scope: Eq. (1) voltage interpolation and the high-order and grid-injected harmonic mechanisms of IV-C and IV-E in the cited CIRED circuit. Original Table II values and closed-loop XTAP traces require additional source data.

assumptions.bridge: Ideal, three wire, stiff DC, no dead time, no leakage or parasitic common-mode path.
assumptions.operating_point: Fundamental bridge phasor by AC load flow for 4.2 kW and zero var at the infinite bus of the nominal circuit. No closed-loop controller. Freeze this command across models and changes of cable, resistance, or carrier.
assumptions.pwm: Symmetric triangular carrier, common to the three legs, valley at zero, reference sampled and held at each peak and valley, no overmodulation.
assumptions.target_circuit: CIRED 2019 Figure 1–2, transformer represented by unity-ratio balanced leakage, midpoint shunt line capacitance. Resistances lumped on three inductors, Cline ideal.
